stance: Growth: Q3 advance GDP printed 3.4% SAAR, up from 2.2% in Q2, so activity re-accelerated. This matches strong nominal consumer spending (September retail sales +0.77% m/m, +6.29% y/y; part is gasoline, ex-gas +0.2%, unconfirmed beyond one source) and positive core capex orders (+0.46% in September after +1.55%). No consensus was found, so beat or miss is unknown. Watch the control group, real spending, core capex and later GDP estimates.
